e.title: Reinsurance Networks (AKL)
e.summary: 再保网络级联损失论文代码（arXiv 1805.12222）：NAIC Schedule F 构建网络+Eisenberg-Noe 清算+传染模拟
e.body: reinsurance_networks 是论文《Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks》（arXiv:1805.12222）的代码：用 NAIC Schedule F 的分保保费数据构建再保网络图、用 Eisenberg-Noe 清算算法计算均衡负债、稀疏矩阵实现、模拟冲击与传染并生成图——研究再保险网络中的系统性风险与级联损失。对 RIAA：再保险网络/系统性风险的前沿研究实现（理解『再保把风险连在一起』的量化分析）。与 [[reinsurer]]（再保险建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 互补。

e.summary_en: Paper code for cascading losses in reinsurance networks (arXiv 1805.12222): NAIC Schedule F network construction + Eisenberg-Noe clearing + contagion simulation
e.summary_hk: 再保網絡級聯損失論文代碼（arXiv 1805.12222）：NAIC Schedule F 構建網絡+Eisenberg-Noe 清算+傳染模擬
e.body_en: reinsurance_networks is the code of the paper 'Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks' (arXiv:1805.12222): constructing reinsurance-network graphs from NAIC Schedule F ceded-premium data, computing equilibrium liabilities with the Eisenberg-Noe clearing algorithm (sparse-matrix implementation), and simulating shocks and contagion with figure generation — studying systemic risk and cascading losses in reinsurance networks. For RIAA: a frontier research implementation of reinsurance networks/systemic risk (quantifying how reinsurance links risks together). Complements [[reinsurer]] (reinsurance modelling), [[insurance-governance]] (model governance), [[actuarial-pricing]] and [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: reinsurance_networks 是論文《Cascading Losses in Reinsurance Networks》（arXiv:1805.12222）的代碼：用 NAIC Schedule F 的分保保費數據構建再保網絡圖、用 Eisenberg-Noe 清算算法計算均衡負債、稀疏矩陣實現、模擬衝擊與傳染並生成圖——研究再保險網絡中的系統性風險與級聯損失。對 RIAA：再保險網絡/系統性風險的前沿研究實現（理解『再保把風險連在一起』的量化分析）。與 [[reinsurer]]（再保險建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（模型治理）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 互補。
